tool_description: HairRemoval eliminates hair artifacts from dermoscopic images via morphological filtering and inpainting. Optionally, it can output a binary hair mask.
demo_commands:
docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/SDDI:/data 
  hair_removal 
  python hair_removal.py /data/imagesTs/ISIC_0547983.jpg -o out_dir

input_image.description: Absolute path to the dermoscopic image (PNG/JPG) containing hairs.

output_dir.description: Directory where the cleaned image (and optional mask) will be saved.

save_mask.description: If true, also saves a binary hair mask in the output directory.

clean_image_png.description: Path to the image with hairs removed.

hair_mask_png.description: (If requested) Path to the binary hair mask (1 = hair, 0 = background).
